idea-plugin.name: Repo Lens
idea-plugin.description:
A code review navigator. Repo Lens collects review candidates into one tool window, jumps from any finding straight to the code, and copies findings as structured Markdown you can paste into any AI chat or review thread.

Checks: large files, types and functions; too many parameters; deep nesting; package dependency cycles; unused public API candidates; oversized diffs; long-lived TODO / FIXME markers; hotspots (change frequency combined with structural findings, with a fully explainable score).

Scopes: Project, Current File, Selected Files, Module, Local Changes, and Branch Diff (merge-base against your base branch, uncommitted and untracked work included).

Languages: universal checks run on any text file; structure analysis covers Java, Kotlin, Go, and JavaScript / TypeScript / JSX / TSX through optional providers that load only when the matching language plugin is present. Git-based evidence (change frequency, author counts, marker age) appears when the Git plugin is available.

Noise control: filters, per-finding ignore, pattern-based suppress rules, and exclusion globs. Findings are evidence with measured values and thresholds, never verdicts.

Repo Lens calls no AI API, stores no keys, requires no server, sends nothing anywhere, and writes the clipboard only on an explicit Copy action.

action.description: Collect Repo Lens review candidates for the selected files
